A patch set for DeepSeek Harness that repairs fused tool-call argument text at the llm/stream seam and re-throws whatever it cannot prove: a call is dispatched only when every fragment parses to a plain object, the first call keeps its id and synthesized ones are marked, and a stream that cannot be split keeps its original error instead of a success. It also listens on agent/request-error to name the deterministic refusals it will not retry, answers per failure class which patch covers it and whether that patch is switched on in the profile you point it at, and reads multi-frame zstd session logs offline to count every turn ending and every error code. Everything it claims is registered with the seam it touches and the limits it does not cross; the resolver never invents a value and never downgrades a configured setting.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的补丁集：在 llm/stream 接缝上修复粘连的工具调用参数，证不出来的原样抛回——只有每个片段都能解析成普通对象才派发，首个调用保留原 id、合成调用有标记，拆不开的流保留原始错误而不是伪装成功。它还挂在 agent/request-error 上命名那些不重试的确定性拒绝，按失败类回答哪个补丁覆盖它、以及它在你指定的 profile 里是否启用，并离线读取多帧 zstd 会话日志统计每种 turn 结束方式与每个错误码。它的每条断言都登记了接缝与不越过的边界；决策层从不凭空造值，也从不擅自降档。

description.en: 在DSH中使用WSL
Native MiniMax for DeepSeek Harness: chat with a subscription (Coding Plan) key or a pay-as-you-go API key, plus image, video, speech and music generation over the official MiniMax API.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接用 MiniMax 官方 API 聊天、画图、做视频、配音和生成音乐，订阅或按量付费都行。

description.en: 让 DSH 干活时用正文报进度，而不是憋到最后一次性汇报 · A DeepSeek Harness plugin
description.zh: 让 DSH 干活时边做边用正文报进度，不用等到最后才一次性汇报，随时掌握进展。

description.en: DSH 助手人格与长期记忆插件：独立可用，不依赖其它插件。管 AI 自身的名字与角色、对用户的称呼、回复风格与自定义指令；人设支持全局 + 按工作区两级覆盖；长期记忆走三段式（候选捕获 → 待审缓冲区 → 用户裁决才生效），并支持一键导入其它 AI 的历史记忆。
description.zh: 给 AI 助手定人设、起名字、管称呼和回复风格，还能记住长期偏好，记忆生效前需你确认。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 输入框的下一句建议：助手回复完，空输入框里出现一句灰色建议，按 Tab 填入
description.zh: 助手回复完，输入框里自动冒出一句灰色建议，按 Tab 直接填入，帮你少打字。

description.en: Screenshot in, working UI out: several agents rebuild the same reference interface in parallel, and you adopt the live result you like best. A DeepSeek Harness plugin.
description.zh: 上传一张界面截图，多个 Agent 并行复刻出可运行的前端页面，挑最顺眼的直接用。

description.en: 把 DeepSeek Harness 的审批弹窗、沙箱拒绝和「建议你自己执行」的推脱去掉，让自定义提示词每轮进入系统提示。27 条宿主补丁 · 20 层自检 · 探针回显 / Strips DSH approval prompts, sandbox denials and hedging; injects your prompt every turn.
description.zh: 只做减法的 DSH 发行版，拆掉审批、沙箱和拦截，带 27 条补丁与 20 层自检，可探针验证。

description.en: 将 ZCode 订阅反代接入 DeepSeek Harness 的插件，支持 Z.AI / BigModel 与 Coding Plan / Start Plan
UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent customizable left Dock, cross-workspace pinned chats, a draft-first home, global search, a completion inbox and right-panel video previews.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供常驻可自定义的左侧 Dock、跨工作区置顶会话、先写草稿的首页、全局搜索、完成通知收件箱，以及右侧文件面板视频预览。

description.en: Mistral Vibe in DeepSeek Harness: a self-contained Mistral La Plateforme provider with the current Vibe model catalogue, per-model thinking levels mapped to reasoning_effort, streaming reasoning blocks, and a settings page that stores the whole model list.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里接入 Mistral 官方平台，自带 Vibe 模型目录，还能按模型调思考强度、流式输出推理过程。

description.en: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 侧栏「会话统计」插件：Token/成本估算（按各厂商原厂官方价目）、DSH 运行状态实时采样、按模型分色的每日堆叠柱与环形图。零第三方依赖。
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏加一个会话统计页，实时看 Token 消耗、预估成本和运行状态，图表按模型分色。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：为 Web 侧边栏增加「会话统计」页，汇总 Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中、会话排行、对话性能与运行时状态。  A DSH plugin that adds a session statistics page to the Web sidebar.
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏加一个会话统计页，Token 消耗、成本、缓存命中、会话排行和性能状态一眼看清。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness计费
Cut the input-token cost of long DeepSeek Harness sessions: source-side tool-output compression on tools/post-execute plus per-agent tool-catalogue visibility, with a measurement script.
实现与 WorkBuddy 高度一致的拖拽/粘贴文件引用体验

HeroUI v3 theme builder for DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop: live Accent hue, Base tint, font family, radius, form radius and light/dark controls, applied as one token-override layer with HeroUI Slider, Tabs and Select.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 与桌面端提供 HeroUI v3 主题构建器：实时调节 Accent 色相、Base 彩度、字体、圆角、表单圆角与明暗模式，通过单层令牌覆盖生效，设置控件使用 HeroUI Slider、Tabs 与 Select。

description.en: Turns the sidebar into a project view and gives each project a room with a shared board, task-line columns filled from message routing, and per-project member avatars.
description.zh: 把侧栏变成项目视图，并给每个项目一个房间：公共看板、按消息归线填充的任务线分列，以及项目内的成员头像。

description.en: Drag any sidebar panel to reorder it, or drop one onto More to fold it into the More submenu; the order and the folded set are remembered across restarts.
description.zh: 拖动左侧栏任意面板调整顺序，或把它拖到「更多」上收进二级菜单；顺序与收纳状态重启后保留。

description.en: Read-only Git graph tab for the DSH right sidebar — colored branch/merge lanes, HEAD / branch / tag / remote badges, commit details with a changed-file tree and per-file diff, virtualized rows that page through large histories — plus a branch chip in the composer that searches local and remote branches and switches with guards against uncommitted changes, detached worktrees and in-progress merges or rebases.
description.zh: DSH 右侧栏的只读 Git 图谱标签页：彩色分支/合并泳道，HEAD / 分支 / 标签 / 远程徽标，提交详情含变更文件树与单文件 diff，行虚拟化、大量提交也翻页流畅；输入框里还有一枚分支胶囊，可搜索本地与远程分支并切换，切换前会检查未提交改动、已被其他 worktree 检出、进行中的 merge / rebase，会覆盖改动时直接拒绝。

description.en: Push notifications for DeepSeek Harness: the reply text itself plus approval and question prompts, delivered in parallel to Bark and optional Gotify, ntfy, PushDeer, ServerChan, PushPlus, extra Bark servers or a custom webhook, with per-workspace and per-session mute.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的推送通知：直接推送回复正文，以及授权与提问提醒；Bark 之外可并行投递到 Gotify、ntfy、PushDeer、Server酱、PushPlus、额外 Bark 服务器或自定义 Webhook，并支持工作区级与会话级静音。

description.en: Feishu (Lark) group notifications for DeepSeek Harness: when a turn ends, pushes a compact digest — conclusion, artifacts and follow-ups — to a custom-bot webhook. Successful turns without follow-ups batch into one-line messages per project; failures and pending items get a detail card; the full text is archived locally; sends retry with exponential backoff and alert after repeated failures.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 每个回合的结果压缩成「结论 / 产物 / 待办」推送到飞书群自定义机器人：成功且无待办的回合按项目聚合成一行型消息，失败或含待办时发详情卡片，可选 LLM 压缩并带本地兜底，全文本地归档，发送失败指数退避重试、连续失败后告警。

description.en: Right-sidebar novel studio that treats a chapter as a pipeline with checkable artefacts instead of one long prompt: scaffold a project, inspect the exact context pack a chapter gets, generate 2-6 parallel candidates and keep the one you pick, then run chapters in sequence with per-chapter progress on disk so it survives an engine restart. Length band, cross-chapter Jaccard and drift ratio are enforced in code rather than by model self-grading; rejections come back as repair evidence for up to two rewrites. AI-fingerprint metrics are reported against a 3956-chapter human baseline but never block, because the distributions overlap. Ships 7 agent tools. The writing engine is a separate Python package that the plugin installs on first use. Needs Python 3.10+ on PATH (or a path set in the plugin settings).
description.zh: 右栏小说工作台，把「写一章」当成有可核对产物的流水线而不是一段长 prompt：生成骨架，先看清这一章会拿到什么上下文包，同一章一次生成 2–6 版候选挑中才落盘，再按章连写且进度写进磁盘，引擎重启不丢。字数区间、跨章 Jaccard、漂移比写在代码里而不靠模型自评，打回内容回灌为修复证据，最多重写两次；AI 指纹只对照 3956 章人类基线报数、故意不拦，因为两个分布本身重叠。带 7 个 agent 工具。写作引擎是独立 Python 包，首次使用时由插件自己装上。需要 PATH 里有 Python 3.10+（或在插件设置里填解释器路径）。

description.en: Runs allowlisted Python hook scripts on session events and injects the text they return into the next turn, so standing rules live in editable .py files instead of the prompt. Needs Python on PATH; it only runs scripts whose names are on its built-in allowlist.
description.zh: 在会话事件上按白名单运行 Python hook 脚本，并把脚本返回的文本注入下一轮，让常驻规则写在可编辑的 .py 文件里而不是提示词里。需要 PATH 里有 Python；只运行名字在其内置白名单里的脚本。

description.en: Remake a viral short video end to end in one workbench: source clip, character sheet behind a human approval gate before any paid render, AI face swap, frame-sample QA and the final cut, plus a media library, a three-track timeline, and any RunningHub workflow connected by its ID.
description.zh: 爆款短视频复刻工作台：原片、角色图（付费生成前必须人工过审）、换人、抽帧质检、成片五步；附素材库与三轨时间线，填 RunningHub 工作流 ID 即可接入任意工作流。

description.en: Watches installed DSH bundles for load failures and dependency drift, brakes repeatedly failing tools, and attributes token cost per message source.
description.zh: 检查已装 DSH 插件的加载失败与依赖漂移，给反复失败的工具加冷却刹车，并按消息来源归因 token 成本。

description.en: Reads assistant replies aloud while they stream: sentence-by-sentence speech with highlighted lines in a sidebar player, pause, mute and stop controls, and automatic quieting for code blocks. Speech uses the operating system's local voices; its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 边生成边把回复念出来：按句合成语音，侧栏播放器里当前句逐句滚动高亮，可暂停、静音、停止，遇到代码块自动静音。朗读用的是操作系统自带的本地语音；它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: VS Code tabs for the dsh web client: one after the chat view and one in the right sidebar, both an embedded code-server workbench on the current session's directory; the iframe stays mounted outside React so switching tabs only hides it, one code-server process per session on 127.0.0.1 with no auth, and a missing code-server shows the probed paths with install commands and a retry button. Each code-server runs with --auth none on 127.0.0.1, so anything on this machine that can reach that port gets the workbench, including its integrated terminal.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 VS Code 标签页：会话视图里（对话之后）和右侧栏各一个，内嵌 code-server 工作区，工作区跟随当前会话目录；iframe 挂载在 React 之外，切走只是隐藏、切回不重载，每个会话在 127.0.0.1 上独享一个免认证的 code-server 进程；未安装 code-server 时列出探测过的路径并给出安装命令与重试按钮。每个 code-server 以 --auth none 监听 127.0.0.1，本机上任何能访问该端口的程序都能使用这套工作台，包括其集成终端。

description.en: Codex-style left sidebar for the dsh web client: a project/session tree with grouping, pinning, drag reordering, unread and archive state, context menus for both project and session rows, and up/down arrow keys in the composer to recall previously sent messages.
description.zh: dsh Web 客户端的 Codex 风格左侧边栏：项目/会话树，支持分组、置顶、拖拽排序、未读与归档状态，项目行与会话行都有右键菜单；输入框按上下方向键可召回之前发送过的消息。

description.en: Paints a mouse-following WebGL particle field behind the DSH Web UI. The palette follows the light/dark theme; Settings → General has an on/off switch and a selectable frame-rate cap (30/60, plus 120 when the display supports it). It inserts nothing into the composer or transcript scroll tree.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面背后铺一层跟随鼠标的 WebGL 粒子场。配色跟随浅色/深色主题；设置 → 常规里有开关和可选帧率上限（30/60，显示器支持时增加 120）。不会向输入框或会话滚动树插入任何元素。

description.en: Multi-account manager for GitHub Copilot in DSH: device-code sign-in for GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Cloud tenants on `*.ghe.com`, one-click account switching, per-account plan and AI credits display, and a preset Copilot provider route with first-login model catalog fallback.
description.zh: DSH 的 GitHub Copilot 多账号管理：设备码登录（支持 GitHub.com 与使用 `*.ghe.com` 域名的 GitHub Enterprise Cloud）、一键切换账号、每账号套餐与 AI credits 用量展示，预置 Copilot 提供方路由，首次登录兜底填充模型目录。

description.en: A balance and usage card at the bottom of the sidebar: DeepSeek account balance, today token count with input, cache and output breakdown, this session tokens, and the last error when a fetch fails.
description.zh: 侧栏底部的余额与用量卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额、今日 token（含输入、缓存、输出明细）、本会话 token，以及抓取失败时的最近错误。

description.en: Shares one set of Markdown memory files between DSH and WorkBuddy: project memory, user memory and the user profile are injected into the session context, while daily notes stay out of the prompt and are read, appended and archived through the tools. Six tools (status, read, search, append, edit, prune) write back through a cross-process lock, revision check, backup and atomic write, and a panel in the left rail and the right sidebar edits entries, sections and whole files.
description.zh: 让 DSH 与 WorkBuddy 共用一套 Markdown 记忆文件：项目记忆、用户记忆与用户画像会注入会话上下文，当日笔记不进提示词，只通过工具读取、追加与归档。六个工具（status、read、search、append、edit、prune）写回时统一经过跨进程锁、修订号校验、备份与原子写；左侧栏与右侧边栏的面板可编辑条目、整节与整份文件。

description.en: Renders GitHub admonition syntax in messages as alert cards, matching the Hermes desktop look.
description.zh: 把消息里的 GitHub admonition 语法渲染成 alert 卡片，视觉对齐 Hermes 桌面端。

description.en: Inspect and control the UI that other plugins register into DeepSeek Harness slots (placeholder release).
description.zh: 这是个占位版本，装上暂时没任何效果，以后会用来查看和管理其他插件注册到界面上的内容。

description.en: Automatically opens the right sidebar for blank top-level chats on wide screens, skipping saved layouts containing tabs and leaving non-blank chats unchanged.
description.zh: 在宽屏上为顶层空白会话自动展开右侧栏，跳过包含标签页的已保存布局，不更改非空白会话。

description.en: Visual + audible session notices for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web: one tab seat per hot session, a state glyph on every sidebar row, a sound and a popout picture when a session needs you. Six states, three surfaces, one command to install.
description.zh: 给活跃会话在标签栏留个座位，侧边栏显示状态图标，需要你时弹图加响铃提醒。

description.en: Collects sidebar footer plugin entries into a collapsible row.
description.zh: 将侧边栏底部的插件入口收纳为可折叠的一行。

description.en: DSH Web 插件：按 DeepSeek 官方定价把会话 token 用量折算成理论人民币成本，在输入框下方和每个回合末尾显示，可展开按「模型 × 时段」的计价明细。
description.zh: 按 DeepSeek 官方定价把会话 token 用量实时折算成人民币成本，输入框下方和每回合末尾都能看到，还能展开看模型和时段的计价明细。

description.en: DeepSeek 网页伴侣插件：在 DSH Web 中使用自己的 DeepSeek 账号，支持流式聊天、深度思考、搜索、图片与历史会话，以及 Dock / Float / Pop-out 三窗口。适用于 macOS，暂不支持 Desktop。
把文字与图表的双轨输出写进系统提示词：结论先行、按场景配图、图表选型。

QQ Bot channel and D&D 5e Dungeon Master plugin for DeepSeek Harness (fork of @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot; do not enable alongside upstream): /dnd runs turn-based campaigns with 19 `dnd_*` tools for dice, checks, grid positioning, fog and battle maps, story chronicles, snapshot rollbacks and an optional dedicated combat subagent, plus /persona per-chat switching with handoffs, shared Markdown notes, sticker collection, read-only Bilibili tools and per-chat tool-access gating. Direct and group chats default to open in cordis.patch.yml while non-allowlisted QQ chats are blocked from shell and subagents; requires QQBOT_APPID/QQBOT_SECRET or in-app QR binding, with optional sharp for rendered maps and ffmpeg for audio/video. Shared notes are visible to every session, so private-chat content may be recalled in groups.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人与 D&D 5e 跑团主持人插件（基于 @tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot 二次开发，勿与上游原版同时启用）：通过 /dnd 与 19 个 `dnd_*` 工具结算掷骰、检定、网格站位、迷雾与战斗地图、剧情账本、快照回滚及可选独立战斗子代理，并支持 /persona 分会话人设切换与交接、共享 Markdown 笔记、表情收藏、B 站只读工具与按会话工具权限拦截。默认补丁中私聊与群聊为开放模式，非白名单 QQ 会话默认禁用终端与子代理；需配置 QQBOT_APPID/QQBOT_SECRET 或端内扫码绑定，图片地图可选装 sharp、音视频需 ffmpeg。共享笔记对所有会话可见，私聊内容可能在群里被召回。

description.en: ADHD-friendly output for DeepSeek Harness: action-first replies, numbered steps, visible wins. Port of ayghri/i-have-adhd. /i-have-adhd on demand, /adhd on for always-on.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的输出更对 ADHD 友好：先给下一步动作，步骤编号，进展看得见。

description.en: Bounded-context memory for long-running dsh conversations and large group chats, with a focus-limited person pipeline, a fixed injection budget, and append-only event archives.
description.zh: 面向长期运行和大群聊的 dsh 对话记忆：焦点限制个人管线、固定注入预算、append-only 事件归档。

description.en: 把 mermaid 代码围栏渲染成图，并把结果缓存进内存和 IndexedDB。同一张图第二次出现时，渲染器直接下班。
description.zh: 对话里的 mermaid 代码直接渲染成图，能缩放、全屏、导出 SVG，还会缓存，同一张图不用重画。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings a second player into your Minecraft Java Edition world. Chat with it in-game and ask it to mine, gather materials, or place blocks.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 以第二名玩家身份进入 Minecraft 世界，在游戏里聊天指挥它挖矿、采集和放置方块。

description.en: Ask MySQL, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch and CSV/Excel in plain language inside DeepSeek Harness — charts, dashboards, alerts, and IM bots for Lark/Feishu, Telegram, WeCom and DingTalk.
Генерируй контент, не выходя из харнесса: каталог OpenRouter, рейтинги, «Едем на халяву» и генерация картинок/видео/озвучки для DeepSeek Harness. Требует Web-профиль DSH (webServer).
给 dsh-pet 的增强插件：能闲聊、能看屏干活、能口述带教并写入本机技能。
RPA 中心（DSH 插件）：拼多多推广/订单/财务/账户余额等日常自动化的统一入口，作业 × 店铺
Connect SQLite, PostgreSQL, or MySQL databases in DeepSeek Harness: browse table structure and data, run SQL, and let the assistant query and edit data directly in the conversation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中连接 SQLite / PostgreSQL / MySQL 数据源：浏览表结构与数据、执行 SQL，也可以在对话里让助手直接查数和改数。

description.en: Git workbench for DeepSeek Harness: session-header chips keep branch, change count and sync state at hand for in-place switching, review and pull/push; the full window adds a lane commit graph, block-level staging, interactive rebase and history rewrite with restore points, batch cherry-pick, a three-way conflict editor, inline blame, worktree management and Git LFS import/export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 工作台：会话标题栏芯片常驻分支、改动数与同步状态，可就地切分支、看改动、拉取推送；完整窗口提供泳道提交图、逐块暂存、带恢复点的交互式变基与历史改写、批量 cherry-pick、三方冲突编辑器、行内 blame、worktree 管理与 Git LFS 迁入迁出。

description.en: Project reporting in the DSH sidebar: draft a per-project report from its git commits and session records with one click, run it on a built-in schedule with a configurable daily cutover offset, and optionally submit Moka overtime automatically; all sessions of a project share one report.
description.zh: 侧栏「项目汇报」：一键整理本项目的代码提交与会话记录生成工作汇报，支持内置定时运行与自定义每日切分偏移，可选自动提交 Moka 加班；同一项目的所有会话共享同一份汇报。

description.en: Reverse Engineer Anything (REA) as a DeepSeek Harness plugin: rea MCP server behind a tool-filter proxy plus the vendored reverse-engineer-anything skill, all on one toggle.
description.zh: 一键开启逆向工程全套工具，MCP 服务加技能包都给你备好了，开箱就能用。

description.en: Reading plugin for DeepSeek Harness: PDF and ebooks with side-by-side Chinese translation, evidence capture, topic comparison, and pixel whale girl library themes.
A DSH agent preset that turns one session into a small, coordinated research team.
description.zh: 一个会话就能拉起一支小研究团队，分工协作帮你查资料、做调研。

description.en: Rigor for agent answers — measure how much the model thinks before it acts, audit unsourced claims, and send non-compliant answers back for a redo.
Changes how DSH Web sends messages: Enter inserts a newline and sending takes Cmd on macOS or Ctrl elsewhere.
description.zh: 调整 DSH Web 的消息发送方式：Enter 只换行，发送用 Cmd（macOS）或 Ctrl。

description.en: DSH插件：商汤生图模型调用插件
description.zh: 在设置里存多个商汤生图账号，Agent 用 generate_image 工具一键调用模型出图。

description.en: Sidebar registry for SSH servers, expiry dates and service URLs, with Windows DPAPI-encrypted password and private-key storage, explicit host-key verification, login tests, and agent SSH execution that asks per command by default or can follow the session permission.
description.zh: 在侧栏登记 SSH 服务器、到期日期和服务网址，使用 Windows DPAPI 加密保存密码和导入私钥，支持显式核对主机指纹和登录测试；Agent SSH 命令默认逐次授权，也可改为跟随会话权限。

description.en: DSH 面板：在一个界面里统一管理 skill 与 MCP。全局/工作区/会话三层开关、别名备注、分组、悬停提示、自建 MCP 服务器。
description.zh: 在一个面板里统一管理 skill 和 MCP，三层开关加别名备注分组，再也不用翻文件改配置。

description.en: dsh存储空间分析及迁移插件
description.zh: 帮你分析 DSH 存储空间占用，还能把数据迁移到别处，省心又省地儿。

description.en: Project spaces, group chats, task boards, memory and usage for teams of DSH bots
description.zh: 把一群 DSH 机器人组建成团队，用项目群聊、任务板和共享记忆一起协作干活。

description.en: DSH plugin: fix Pandoc-style $$ display-math blocks that DSH mis-parses into a red KaTeX parse error.
description.zh: 修好 Pandoc 风格 $$ 公式块在 DSH 里被误解析、公式首行丢失和 KaTeX 报错的问题。

description.en: 资产账本 | Multi-account, multi-asset, multi-currency portfolio & trade ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)
DeepSeek Harness 桌面挂件插件：Gemini拟人形象；支持 DSH 余额与轮次花费、Gemini 5h/周额度同步（agy / RT / OAuth）、自定义立绘裁剪、提示音效与趣味陪伴互动。
description.zh: 把 Gemini 猫娘挂件放到 DSH 桌面上，随时看余额、花费和 Gemini 额度，还能换立绘、听提示音、陪聊互动。

description.en: DSH plugin for durable cross-session memory and todos: five tracks (global, user, project, key, daily), confirmation-gated writes, in-place adoption of existing memories and optional per-project Git sync
description.zh: 给 AI 助手装上跨会话的长期记忆和待办清单，重要内容确认后才写入，还能直接接管已有记忆。

description.en: 从需求到原型：一句话需求，问清关键规则后产出精简 PRD、流程图、可交互原型和确认单的 Agent skill。From requirement to prototype: an Agent skill that turns a one-line requirement into a concise PRD, flow diagrams, an offline clickable prototype and a confirmation sheet (output in Chinese).
description.zh: 一句话需求就能生成精简PRD、流程图和可交互原型，还会先问清关键规则，适合把需求交给别人实现。

description.en: Natural-language poster studio plugin for DeepSeek Harness — a floating design panel plus chat tools: say what you want (改标题、换背景、调色、删层、导出 PNG) in any session, or edit visually. Site shader backdrop, CN/EN fonts, layer system, palettes, version history.

鱼眼 / See on Phone —— 让 AI 住进手机：在手机上直接和模型聊天，需要时用自己的摄像头看世界（取帧 → 挑帧 → 拼宫格）。导盲只是其中一个可选读者。An Android app + a DSH plugin that let an agent chat on the phone and see the real world. Blind navigation is one optional mode, not the product.
description.zh: 让 AI 住进手机：在手机上直接和模型聊天，需要时用摄像头看世界，取帧拼宫格，还能帮盲人导航。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: Russian text for a reader outside the context - a law, genre templates and a 120-metric style check inside the session.
description.zh: 让俄语文本脱离上下文也能读懂，内置体裁模板和120项文风检查，帮你在会话里直接优化写作。

description.en: Four-pointed star (FPS) adds long-task status, tool summaries, session outputs, persistent attachment drafts, native voice integration, provider usage, compatibility checks, and optional image generation to DSH.
description.zh: Four-pointed star（FPS）为 DSH 增加长任务状态、工具摘要、会话产物、附件持久化、原生语音接入、服务商用量、兼容性自检和可选生图。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：会话水位、交接文档体检与上下文压缩续跑
description.zh: 管好长会话的上下文水位，帮你体检交接文档、压缩续跑，不丢已有信息。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 会议记录插件：系统声音 + 麦克风混音录音、本地离线转写、一键生成会议纪要（不联网、不上传音频）
description.zh: 把系统声音和麦克风混着录下来，本地离线转成文字，再一键整理成会议纪要。

description.en: Per-model, per-session header gate for DeepSeek Harness pi-ai requests: stamps configurable headers on calls to trusted origins, pinning each session's first decision. TDAI memory proxy identity headers are the shipped default; names, values and origins are configurable.
description.zh: 按模型和会话给 pi-ai 请求打上记忆身份头，首次选定后自动固定，省心又稳定。

description.en: Token-rate-driven Tetris overlay for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
description.zh: Agent 干活时在对话界面前浮出俄罗斯方块，方块下落速度跟着 token 输出速率实时变化，边等边玩。

description.en: 记忆自动放行 + AI 预审 + 审批集中预览 + 右侧栏 diff/撤销，把归属写成事实的 DSH 审批中枢
description.zh: 给 DSH 加一层审批大脑：能自动放行的自动放，该问你的才问，事后还能查、能撤回。

description.en: 把 Tailnet / 反向代理页面当作「本机」来用：启用 host 持久化设置，并按需关闭浏览器会话校验（Host/Origin 栅栏保持不动）。
description.zh: 让 DSH 设置页在 Tailnet 或反向代理地址上也能当本机用，按需关闭浏览器会话校验。

description.en: Token usage & cost report for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): composer spend chip, per-day × per-model usage page, peak/off-peak pricing, date ranges, CSV export. Data stays local.
description.zh: 在输入框看实时花费，按天按模型查用量，支持峰谷价和 CSV 导出，数据只存本地。

description.en: Token usage analytics and model capability leaderboard for DeepSeek Harness - privacy-first, local session logs only.
description.zh: 扫描本机会话日志，按模型统计 token 消耗趋势，还能看模型能力排行。

description.en: 让 AI 直接调用 ffmpeg / ripgrep / fd / jq / yt-dlp：装工具、看实时控制台、归档脚本，一个页面搞定。
description.zh: 让 AI 直接调用 ffmpeg、ripgrep、fd、jq、yt-dlp 等命令行工具，装工具、看实时控制台、归档脚本一个页面全搞定。

description.en: DSH 的工作记忆插件。上下文一压缩、一换窗口，前面聊过的东西就没了；这个插件负责把「丢了就再也找不回来」的那部分留在盘上，并在下一轮重新摆到模型眼前。
description.zh: 把上下文压缩后容易丢的工作记忆存到本地，下一轮再摆回模型眼前，任务进度不丢。

description.en: 让局域网内所有安装本插件的 DeepSeek Harness 实例以账号身份互相发现、可靠地互发消息聊天。
description.zh: 让局域网里装了本插件的 DSH 实例以账号身份互相发现、可靠地私聊，断网也能补发消息。

description.en: AI-native SSH / Telnet / serial terminal for DeepSeek Harness — humans and AI agents share the same sessions, files and diagnostics. 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 原生 SSH / Telnet / 串口终端：人与 AI 共用会话、终端、文件与诊断。
description.zh: 让人类和 AI 共用同一个 SSH/Telnet/串口终端，会话、文件、诊断都能一起看、一起操作。

description.en: Arknights lore memory for DeepSeek Harness: faction files, alias routing, in-world timeline, full story archive, PRTS live lookup and dynamic updates.
DeepAI Code models for DeepSeek Harness: browser OAuth, no desktop client, no gateway process.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接接入 DeepAI Code 模型，浏览器 OAuth 登录，不用装客户端也不用跑网关。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for building and testing Android apps on your phone.
description.zh: 在手机上让 Agent 帮你做 Android 应用，先预览效果，再打包成能独立安装的 App。

description.en: 用于bilibili的大肥鱼插件，支持ASR视频字幕读取，回复评论，主动阅读视频
description.zh: B站大肥鱼插件，能读视频字幕做带时间戳的总结，还会自动回复未读评论、定时发视频摘要。

description.en: 人生看板 · 把 markdown 日志折成五张卡（健康/任务/资产/情绪/书架）。Local-only life dashboard for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把你平时写的 markdown 日志折成健康、任务、资产、情绪、书架五张卡，本地只读看板，不用建库也不上云。

description.en: DSH 插件：在聊天中提供图像/视频生成工具，基于 OpenAI 兼容 API
description.zh: 在聊天里直接生成图片和视频，基于 OpenAI 兼容接口，让 AI 助手能画能拍。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 皮肤与壁纸插件：8 套预设、12 套自定义配色、9 套渐变；本地视频壁纸支持播放列表、进度拖动、整页全屏与声音。
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 换皮肤、换配色，还能用本地视频当壁纸，带播放列表和全屏。

description.en: Native Sign in with ChatGPT provider for DeepSeek Harness (Cordis). OAuth, live model discovery, Responses streaming, reasoning replay and cache affinity. English / 简体中文.
Use Tokener models in DeepSeek Harness (dsh): install the plugin, connect your API key, and pick a model.
description.zh: 装上这个插件、填好 API Key，就能在 DSH 里直接用 Tokener 的模型，一个账号搞定多种模型。

description.en: Caelum Orbis（环枢）— always-on 3D agent status HUD and execution visualizer for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 不用开面板，对话区右侧自动浮出玻璃 HUD，实时显示 Agent 当前任务、阶段进度和最近完成的事。

description.en: 给 DeepSeek Harness 的免密钥联网搜索：四家引擎聚合 + 网页正文读取，还能把内置 web_search 从按次计费的官方搜索切到免费引擎。
description.zh: 免密钥联网搜索插件，聚合四家搜索引擎还能读网页正文，可把内置搜索换成免费引擎省钱。

description.en: Adaptive AI engineering presets for DeepSeek Harness—architecture, development, QA, and DevOps with shared guidelines and configurable collaboration.
Session-scoped environment, context, plugins and read-only Git changes in the DSH right sidebar.
description.zh: 在 DSH 右侧边栏按会话展示环境、上下文、插件和只读 Git 变更，方便随时掌握当前会话状态。

description.en: Resumable ACP subagent backend for DeepSeek Harness — persistent chat pool with session/load reconnect & mid-turn steering. Tested with kiro-cli.
description.zh: 让 ACP 子智能体跨轮次保持存活、断线可续聊，还能中途插话调整方向。

description.en: Provide transition for DSH’s Web UI Element, like menus, etc. 为 DSH 的 Web UI 界面元素（包括菜单等）提供过渡动画。
description.zh: 给 DSH 的 Web UI 元素和菜单加上过渡动画，让界面切换更顺滑自然。

description.en: Word Master for DeepSeek Harness — agent preset 形式把素材做成规范 Word 文档：素材转换 → 规格冻结 → 逐节写作 → 质检门 → 审阅界面 → 渲染闸门 → 导出。架构范式学习自 PPT Master。
description.zh: 把零散素材自动写成规范 Word 文档，从写作到质检、审阅、导出全流程搞定。

description.en: DSH 标题栏用量 HUD：余额 / 今日已用 / 峰谷倒计时 + 每轮消耗
description.zh: 在 DSH 标题栏常驻显示余额、今日用量和峰谷倒计时，每条回复还标出本轮花了多少。

description.en: EnvDock · Windows 工具链码头：自动探测 Node / Python / Git 与终端，选择默认版本，并把环境简报交给 AI。DeepSeek Harness 插件。(开发中)
description.zh: 自动探测 Windows 上的 Node、Python、Git 和终端，帮你选好默认版本，还能把环境简报交给 AI。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: use your own local OpenCode CLI's models (all your OpenCode providers) inside DSH, the way T3 Code does
galbook：让 agent 像人一样玩 galgame 的库——逐句读、自己选并写理由、存档回溯、多周目解锁；HTTP / MCP / CLI 四种接法，纯标准库，带网页观战与剧本导入
description.zh: 让 AI 像人一样逐句玩 galgame，自己选选项、写理由、存档回溯，还能看见画面。

description.en: Two-phase long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): per-session extraction + global consolidation, always-injected summary, and memory_list/read/search/add tools.
Discover and install community DSH bundles: newbie essentials, recommendations, categories, npm/GitHub search.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏发现、推荐并一键安装社区插件，新手也能快速上手。

description.en: dsh plugin: tool reliability radar over tool-trace data - error rate, failure streaks and p95 latency per tool (/radar)
description.zh: 盯着 agent 的工具调用记录，算出各工具的错误率、连续失败和慢速情况，帮你快速找出哪个工具老翻车、哪个慢得离谱。

description.en: Give DeepSeek Harness eyes for video: samples frames with ffmpeg, reads subtitle tracks and container metadata, answers questions about moments. Install: dsh plugin add dsh-video-vision

Gives your DSH agent a long memory: it remembers past chats, people, and promises, can recall them days later, and keeps a diary linked to the original messages. Old memories fade naturally. Requires Node 22+ and a DeepSeek API key; the installer and desktop notifications are Windows-only.
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 助手记得久一点：聊过的事、重要的人和答应过的话都会记住，过几天问起还能想起来；还会写日记，每条都连着当时的对话。旧记忆会自然淡忘。需要 Node 22+ 和 DeepSeek API key；安装器与桌面通知仅支持 Windows。

description.en: Phone gateway for DeepSeek Harness: control sessions, models, presets, approvals, files, commands and settings from an Android phone.
description.zh: 在安卓手机上远程操控电脑里的 DSH，会话、模型、审批、文件都能随手管。

description.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agents with Obsidian plugin development capabilities: scaffolding, validation, version syncing, plus a development-guidelines skill.
description.zh: 让 DSH 智能体帮你开发 Obsidian 插件，从搭骨架、校验到版本同步一条龙。

description.en: Keyless multi-engine web search + fetch providers for the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web seam — works with any model backend
Four slash commands for session branches: list the branch tree, fork at a completed turn, pin a session together with its whole family, and merge a child branch back into its parent.
description.zh: 会话分支的四个斜杠命令：列出分支树、在已完成的轮次处 fork、把会话连同整个家族置顶、把子分支合并回父会话。

description.en: Merges, appends, and repairs DSH session logs: eleven modes for copying events between sessions, computing compaction cut points, clearing a broken parent link, and validating the result against DSH's own loader.
description.zh: 合并、追加与修复 DSH 会话：十一个模式，覆盖会话之间复制事件、计算压缩切点、断开损坏的父子链，并按 DSH 加载器校验结果。

description.en: Blocks risky tool-call shapes before execution: inline multi-line Python, forwarded content without a source, missing source labels, and memory writes past the character cap. It also asks for confirmation before shell commands, and one rule is specific to the author's WeChat sending workflow.
description.zh: 在执行前拦下高风险的调用形态：内联多行 Python、没有出处的转发内容、缺失来源标签，以及超出字数上限的 memory 写入。它还会在执行 shell 命令前要求确认，其中一条规则是针对作者自己的微信发送流程的。

description.en: Every few turns asks the model whether anything is worth keeping, then sorts the answer into memory, skill or hook.
description.zh: 每几轮让模型判断是否有值得沉淀的经验，并把结论归入 memory、skill 或 hook 三类之一。

description.en: A bookshelf panel for reading .txt novels beside the conversation: import a local file, decode UTF-8, UTF-8 with BOM, UTF-16 or GB18030, split it into chapters, then read with a table of contents, chapter navigation, adjustable font size, line height and column width. Each book resumes at the chapter and scroll position you left it at.
description.zh: 在对话旁边加一个书架面板，用来读本地 .txt 小说：导入文件后识别 UTF-8、带 BOM 的 UTF-8、UTF-16 或 GB18030 编码并自动分章，提供目录、上下章、字号、行距与版心宽度，每本书从上次读到的章节与位置继续。

description.en: External wake bridge for DSH sessions: an out-of-host watcher posts an event to a loopback endpoint, and a failed delivery records nothing so the caller can retry with the same event_id.
description.zh: DSH 会话的外部唤醒桥：宿主外的 watcher 向本地端点投递事件；投递失败不记账，调用方可用同一个 event_id 重试。

description.en: Raises one desktop notification when a turn stops, a question waits, or an approval waits. Each event has its own switch; subagent Sessions stay quiet; a click opens the Session. Uses the page's own Notification API, so there is no helper app or install-time registration.
description.zh: 回合结束、有提问等待回答或有审批等待决定时各发一条桌面通知。每类事件可单独开关；子代理会话不发通知；点击通知打开对应会话。走页面自带的 Notification API，不需要辅助程序或安装时注册。

description.en: Turns a DSH conversation into a floating window that stays usable over plugin and automation pages — on screen, minimised to a left-sidebar taskbar row, or docked into the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把 DSH 对话变成悬浮窗，在插件页与自动化页之上仍旧可用——浮在页面上、缩到左侧边栏任务栏行，或停靠进右侧边栏。

description.en: Shows the balance or Coding Plan quota of the active model provider in the dsh status line, model menu and Current Model label, with background-collected history and trend charts.
description.zh: 在 dsh 状态行、模型菜单与「当前模型」标签显示当前模型供应商的余额或 Coding Plan 额度，后台采集历史数据并以趋势图展示变化。

description.en: Defines named roles that each pair a persona with a bound model and fallback chain, and exposes one delegation tool per role, so subagents are dispatched by role name instead of a provider/model string.
description.zh: 把角色定义成 persona、绑定模型与备用链三部分，每个角色暴露一个委派工具；派发子代理时用角色名即可，不必每次手写 provider/model。

description.en: Back up and restore a whole DSH environment (installed plugins, DSH and plugin settings, skills, sessions and explicitly registered workspace files) into one private GitHub repository. Multiple machines share a single repo through per-device namespaces that never overwrite each other, and a pull can restore from this device, the latest backup or a chosen device. Push previews a read-only plan before writing, pull backs up local data first, secret-looking settings are redacted and key files are never uploaded. It calls api.github.com with the GitHub token you save in the panel (kept host-side only); its HTTP routes (/one-pack/api/...) require DSH browser auth.
description.zh: 把整套 DSH 环境（已装插件、DSH 与插件设置、技能、会话、显式登记的工作区文件） 打包同步到一个私有 GitHub 仓库。多台设备共用同一仓库时各写自己的设备命名空间、 互不覆盖，拉取可选本设备、最新备份或指定设备；推送前先只读预览计划，拉取前自动 备份本地数据；疑似密钥字段写成掩码、密钥文件硬排除，GitHub token 只保存在 Host 本地。它会用面板里保存的 token 访问 api.github.com；HTTP 路由 （/one-pack/api/…）要求 DSH 浏览器鉴权。

description.en: Tool-surface governance for DeepSeek Harness: six scope-separated deny lists cut each agent's tool visibility through the host tools.restrict() API, unseen tool names wait in a pending gate, and dispatch_composed assembles a minimal surface from capability tags — a tasks array runs subagents in parallel, and a continued subagent keeps its original surface. Every decision goes to an append-only ledger that rotates into dated archives without ever losing history.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的工具面治理：六张作用域分开的名单经宿主 tools.restrict() API 逐 agent 裁剪工具可见性，新见工具名进待裁决闸门，dispatch_composed 按能力标签组装最小面——传 tasks 数组可并行跑子代理，续派的子代理保持原有工具面。每次决策写入 append-only 台账，超限轮转为带日期的归档档，历史一条不丢。

description.en: Predicts the next message you would send once an assistant turn finishes and shows it as a one-line suggestion above the composer; Tab or a click fills the draft without sending. The prediction follows the session model unless a provider and model are pinned, and the Settings page has an on/off switch.
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测你下一句会发的消息，以一行建议显示在输入框上方；按 Tab 或点击填入草稿，不会自动发送。预测默认跟随当前会话的模型，也可以在配置里另选模型服务商与模型；设置页有总开关。

description.en: Device inspector and control panel for macOS and Windows that shows hardware, system, software, network, security and processes on one sidebar page and applies 19 whitelisted actions, with a confirmable cleanup scan, a repeatable benchmark and device_info, device_control and device_benchmark tools for the agent.
description.zh: 面向 macOS 与 Windows 的设备检视与操作面板，在侧栏一页展示硬件、系统、软件、网络、安全与进程，执行 19 个白名单操作，并提供需二次确认的磁盘清理扫描、可重复的基准测试，以及 device_info、device_control、device_benchmark 三个 Agent 工具。

description.en: Download task panel for the DSH Web UI: a bundled download_file tool streams the file itself and reports exact byte counts, shell downloads (curl -o, Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile, pip install, git clone) are recognised from host job events, and every task shows its name, real percentage, transfer rate and remaining ETA in the bottom-right corner.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的下载任务面板：插件自带 download_file 工具直接流式下载并统计真实字节数，同时从 host job 事件识别 shell 下载（curl -o、Invoke-WebRequest -OutFile、pip install、git clone）；每个任务在右下角显示名称、真实百分比、下载速率与剩余时间。

description.en: A multi-project todo board inside DSH: capture notes in a global capsule overlay, group them into projects and mind maps, and export a todo into the composer as a task for the agent. Notes and todos are read and written on the author's hosted service (todo.memorymap.cn) after you sign in; set config.apiBase to point it at your own backend. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check.
description.zh: 把多项目待办工作台装进 DSH：全局胶囊浮层随手记想法，归到项目、拆成脑图，再把待办一键导出到输入框交给 Agent。登录后，笔记与待办的读写都发生在作者托管的服务（todo.memorymap.cn）上；可用 config.apiBase 改指向你自己的后端。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查。

description.en: Adds an analysis tab to each session that draws it as a timeline: swim-lane tracks by category, a flame graph, and per-category and per-tool timing statistics for model calls, tool calls and background processes. Running sessions refresh live, and extra lanes can be defined with regex rules in the plugin config.
description.zh: 给每个会话加一个「分析」标签页，把会话画成时间线：按类别分道的调用轨迹、火焰图，以及按类别、按工具的耗时统计，覆盖模型调用、工具调用与后台进程。运行中的会话自动刷新，可在插件配置里用正则规则自定义泳道。

description.en: Adds a session tab bar under the DSH conversation header: open sessions appear in order with workspace/title labels and status dots; click to switch, use the hover × or the right-click menu to close, rename, close others or close all; the tab list persists in localStorage. Plugin only; it does not change DSH core or stop background work.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部下方增加会话标签栏：打开过的会话按顺序显示为标签（工作区/标题与状态圆点），点击切换，可用悬停 × 或右键菜单关闭、重命名、关闭其他/全部关闭；标签列表持久化在 localStorage。纯插件实现，不改 DSH 核心，也不停止后台任务。

description.en: Campus-network auto-login for DeepSeek Harness: status, one-click login, a local settings page, and an optional autostart watchdog. Includes a Nanjing Audit University preset and a configurable JSON-portal mode.
description.zh: 校园网自动登录插件：查看状态、一键登录、本地设置页和可选的开机自启守护。内置南京审计大学预设，也支持自定义 JSON 门户。

description.en: Archives scripts written in any DSH session into a per-category folder, writes a Markdown doc for each one, and starts or stops them with status verified against real processes and scheduled tasks.
description.zh: 把任意会话里写出的脚本归档到按类别分好的目录，逐个生成 Markdown 文档，并能启动/停止、按真实进程与计划任务核对状态。

description.en: Hide or show individual DeepSeek Harness sidebar entries from a settings page without disabling the plugin; includes in-plugin update.
description.zh: 在设置页逐个隐藏或显示 DSH 左侧边栏的插件入口，无需停用插件；带插件内更新。

description.en: A long-form fiction writing desk inside DeepSeek Harness: a shelf of books, a three-column editor (chapter tree, prose, AI assistant), outlines, character/world/foreshadowing notes, story archives, and an AI assistant whose prose and note edits are reviewed before they are written. Interface and AI prompts are bilingual (Chinese and English), manuscripts stay local in SQLite, and the model uses the DeepSeek service already configured in Harness.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 里的长篇小说写作台：书架、三栏编辑器（目录、正文、AI 助手）、大纲、角色 / 世界观 / 伏笔资料、故事档案，以及会先给出可审阅的正文与资料改动、确认后才写入的 AI 助手。界面与 AI 提示词支持中英双语，书稿保存在本地 SQLite，模型复用 Harness 中已配置的 DeepSeek 服务。

description.en: Syncs the same DeepSeek account's terminals: plugin inventory and enablement, app settings, selected workspace files, session logs and skills / agent presets. Four transports (shared folder, git, WebDAV, LAN) and five independent content toggles, with a dry-run plan, conflict copies and additive-only session import. Its optional LAN transport listens on 0.0.0.0 (port 47810 by default) and is protected only by a pairing token over plain HTTP; synced app settings and workspace files are not encrypted by the plugin (secrets are stripped before publishing).
description.zh: 同步同一 DeepSeek 账号下的多台终端：插件清单与启用状态、应用设置、选定的工作区文件、会话记录、技能 / Agent 预设。四种传输方式（共享文件夹、Git、WebDAV、局域网）与五类独立内容开关，支持预演计划、冲突副本和会话只增不改。可选的 LAN 传输默认监听 0.0.0.0（端口 47810），只靠配对令牌保护且走明文 HTTP；同步的应用设置和工作区文件不由插件加密（发布前会剔除密钥）。

description.en: Adds a Plan/Build switch to the composer chip and to the Tab key, keeping a separate model and reasoning effort per mode and restoring them on every toggle, /plan, and plan approval.
description.zh: 在输入框的 chip 上用 Tab 键切换 Plan/Build，每个模式各自记住模型与 reasoning 强度，切换、/plan 与批准计划后自动恢复。
